description: Dark mode (prefers-color-scheme + manual toggle persisted to localStorage) and automatic WCAG-AA text color on team-color badges. This is the core of Issue #22 criteria (1) and the theming half of criterion (3). Introduce CSS custom properties for ALL themeable colors in frontend/src/styles.css with a light palette on :root and a dark palette under [data-theme="dark"]; add a pure theme resolver + a ThemeToggle header control mirroring the existing LanguageToggle/localStorage pattern; add a pure readableTextColor(hex) helper and use it in TeamBadge. Verified by unit tests including an all-team-colors AA contrast test. SETUP for this task also happens here (install @axe-core/playwright dep and the Playwright chromium browser) so later e2e features can run; the dep install is bundled here because the baseline (build + 196 unit tests) is already confirmed green by the architect.
steps: ENV SETUP (do first): from repo root with PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH", run `npm install -D @axe-core/playwright -w @mlb/frontend` (registry reachable; resolves @axe-core/playwright@4.13.0) and `node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js install chromium` to install the browser (~/.cache/ms-playwright is currently empty). Confirm baseline stays green: `npm run build` and `npm test` both pass (architect already confirmed 196 unit tests pass).

Create frontend/src/theme.ts: a small, pure, well-documented module. Export type ThemePreference = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system' and type ResolvedTheme = 'light' | 'dark'. Export const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'mlb.theme'. Export a guarded readStoredTheme(): ThemePreference | null (safe under jsdom/SSR, try/catch around localStorage, validate against the three allowed values) and storeTheme(pref) mirroring frontend/src/i18n/index.ts readStoredLang/storeLang. Export a PURE resolveTheme(pref: ThemePreference, systemPrefersDark: boolean): ResolvedTheme that returns pref when it is 'light'/'dark' and (systemPrefersDark ? 'dark' : 'light') when 'system'. Export a helper getSystemPrefersDark(): boolean that reads window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches, guarded for environments where matchMedia is undefined (return false).

Create a React theme context in frontend/src/theme.tsx (or extend theme.ts) exporting ThemeProvider and useTheme(): { preference, resolved, setPreference }. On mount it hydrates preference from readStoredTheme() ?? 'system'; it computes resolved via resolveTheme + a matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') subscription so that when preference==='system' it reacts live to OS changes (add/removeEventListener('change')); it applies the resolved theme by setting document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', resolved) in a useEffect; setPreference persists via storeTheme. Keep it guarded so it is inert and does not throw under jsdom. Also set the initial data-theme attribute as early as practical to avoid a flash (either an inline bootstrap in main.tsx before React renders, or in index.html — a tiny guarded script reading localStorage 'mlb.theme' and prefers-color-scheme and setting data-theme on <html>). Document whichever approach you choose.
Wire ThemeProvider into frontend/src/main.tsx so the whole app (all routes: HomePage, SeriesDetailPage, AccuracyPage) inherits the theme. Mount it above or beside I18nProvider inside BrowserRouter.

Create frontend/src/readableTextColor.ts: a pure function readableTextColor(hex: string): '#000000' | '#ffffff' that parses a #rgb or #rrggbb hex, computes WCAG relative luminance (sRGB channel linearization: c/255, then c<=0.03928 ? c/12.92 : ((c+0.055)/1.055)**2.4; L = 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B), computes the contrast ratio ((Llighter+0.05)/(Ldarker+0.05)) against both black (#000000) and white (#ffffff), and returns whichever yields the higher contrast ratio (ties -> black). Export also a helper contrastRatio(hexA: string, hexB: string): number so tests can assert the >=4.5 AA threshold. Handle malformed input defensively (fall back to a safe default).

Update frontend/src/components/TeamBadge.tsx: replace the hardcoded fill="#ffffff" on the abbreviation <text> with readableTextColor(primary) imported from ../readableTextColor, so the label color is auto-picked for AA contrast against each team's primary fill. Do not change the badge geometry or the aria-label.

Refactor frontend/src/styles.css to use CSS custom properties for ALL themeable colors. Keep the existing light palette on :root (and keep color-scheme). Add a complete dark palette under a `[data-theme="dark"]` selector that overrides the same variables (and sets `color-scheme: dark`). Introduce semantic variables as needed (e.g. --surface, --surface-2 for card/panel backgrounds like #fbfcfe / #f1f5f9, --bg, --ink, --muted, --border, --accent, status chip bg/fg pairs for scheduled/in_progress/final, winner/leader row backgrounds #ecfdf5/#f1f5f9, notice/integrity/offline backgrounds, the gold champion color, link colors like the accuracy nav #2563eb, accuracy table borders #e2e8f0, detail/game backgrounds). Replace the hardcoded hex usages throughout the file (series-card, series-team, series-card__status, detail, standings, prediction incl. accuracy slider & metrics, accuracy page table/bars, notices, refresh bar, season buttons) with the variables so dark mode covers the NEWER UI (refresh bar from #17, accuracy page from #16, prediction basis block, detail page), not just the original screens. Ensure every foreground/background pair in BOTH palettes meets WCAG AA (>=4.5:1 for normal text, >=3:1 for large text/UI). The header gradient (navy) can stay but ensure text on it stays >=4.5:1 in both themes.

Add theme-toggle styling in styles.css: a .app__theme control group matching the .app__lang segmented pill look (three buttons: System / Light / Dark, or a cycle button — pick the segmented-group approach to mirror LanguageToggle and keep it keyboard/SR friendly). Ensure it is legible on the navy header in both themes.

Create frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx mirroring LanguageToggle.tsx: a role="group" with an accessible label (t('app.theme.group')) wrapping three buttons for 'system' | 'light' | 'dark', each with aria-pressed reflecting the current preference, calling setPreference from useTheme(). Localize the labels.

Render <ThemeToggle /> in the HomePage.tsx header next to <LanguageToggle />. Also surface it on AccuracyPage.tsx and SeriesDetailPage.tsx headers/nav (or a shared header area) so the toggle is reachable on every page; at minimum ensure the toggle exists on the main bracket page and the control is consistent with LanguageToggle.

Add i18n strings for the theme control to frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts: extend the MessageKey union AND both MESSAGES.en and MESSAGES.ja with 'app.theme.group', 'app.theme.system', 'app.theme.light', 'app.theme.dark' (EN: 'Theme','System','Light','Dark'; JA: 'テーマ','システム','ライト','ダーク'). Keep both language tables in sync (the type union enforces this).

Add unit tests: (a) frontend/src/readableTextColor.test.ts — the ALL-TEAM-COLORS AA contrast test: import TEAM_COLORS/teamColor and iterate the ENTIRE team table (plus the DEFAULT_COLOR), assert contrastRatio(readableTextColor(primary), primary) >= 4.5 for every team's primary (and ideally secondary where text is drawn on it), directly satisfying 'verified across all team colors'. Also unit-test readableTextColor on known values (white bg -> black text, black bg -> white text) and contrastRatio against known pairs (e.g. black/white == 21). (b) frontend/src/theme.test.ts — pure resolveTheme cases: 'light'->'light', 'dark'->'dark', 'system' with systemPrefersDark true->'dark' and false->'light'; and readStoredTheme validation (valid value round-trips, invalid/absent -> null). (c) a component test for ThemeToggle persistence (frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.test.tsx) following LanguageToggle.test.tsx: render within ThemeProvider, click Dark, assert aria-pressed moves and localStorage 'mlb.theme' === 'dark' (and data-theme attribute flips if asserting on documentElement).
Run `npm run build` and `npm test` from repo root (with the PATH prefix) and confirm all pass before marking complete.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/readableTextColor.ts exports a pure readableTextColor(hex) and contrastRatio(a,b) using the WCAG luminance/contrast formula; readableTextColor('#ffffff')==='#000000' and readableTextColor('#000000')==='#ffffff'.
A unit test iterates the ENTIRE teamColors table and asserts the chosen text color meets >=4.5:1 AA contrast against every team's primary; the test passes.
TeamBadge renders the abbreviation using readableTextColor(primary) rather than a hardcoded #ffffff.

styles.css defines a light palette on :root and a dark palette under [data-theme="dark"]; setting data-theme="dark" on <html> visibly restyles home, detail, and accuracy pages including the refresh bar, prediction basis block, and accuracy table.

ThemeProvider resolves 'system' from prefers-color-scheme, reacts to OS changes via matchMedia when in system mode, applies data-theme to documentElement, and persists the manual choice to localStorage key 'mlb.theme' (values 'light'|'dark'|'system'); resolveTheme is pure and unit-tested.
A ThemeToggle header control (consistent with LanguageToggle) lets the user pick System/Light/Dark with aria-pressed, localized EN/JA, and persistence verified by a component test.
`npm run build` and `npm test` pass from repo root; @axe-core/playwright is installed as a frontend devDependency and chromium is installed for Playwright.
verification: PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build  (ordered build stays green)
PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm test  (all workspaces; new readableTextColor/theme/ThemeToggle tests pass, including the all-team-colors AA contrast test)
Confirm frontend/package.json devDependencies now include @axe-core/playwright and ~/.cache/ms-playwright contains a chromium build
findings:
Completed in commit f54b5c4 on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site.

WHAT WAS DONE:
- ENV SETUP: `npm install -D @axe-core/playwright -w @mlb/frontend` resolved @axe-core/playwright@4.13.0 (now in frontend/package.json devDependencies + package-lock.json). Playwright chromium installed via `node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js install chromium`.
- frontend/src/theme.ts: pure model (ThemePreference/ResolvedTheme, THEME_STORAGE_KEY='mlb.theme', THEME_PREFERENCES, guarded readStoredTheme/storeTheme, pure resolveTheme, guarded getSystemPrefersDark).
- frontend/src/ThemeContext.tsx (NOTE: the context lives in ThemeContext.tsx, NOT theme.tsx — see DEVIATION below): ThemeProvider + useTheme; hydrates from readStoredTheme ?? 'system', live matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') subscription for 'system', applies data-theme on documentElement, persists via storeTheme. Accepts initialPreference for tests.
- frontend/index.html: inline guarded flash-prevention script sets data-theme on <html> before React mounts.
- frontend/src/main.tsx: ThemeProvider wraps I18nProvider inside BrowserRouter so all routes inherit the theme.
- frontend/src/readableTextColor.ts: pure readableTextColor(hex)+contrastRatio(a,b)+relativeLuminance using WCAG formula; ties -> black. TeamBadge now uses readableTextColor(primary) instead of hardcoded #ffffff.
- frontend/src/styles.css: all themeable colors moved to CSS vars on :root (light) + [data-theme=dark] (dark) with color-scheme; covers series cards/status chips, winner/leader rows, notices, refresh bar, season buttons, detail page, standings, prediction (accuracy slider/metrics/basis), accuracy table/captions. Added .app__theme segmented-pill styling mirroring .app__lang, plus .app__controls cluster and detail-page toggle styling.
- frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: role=group System/Light/Dark buttons with aria-pressed, localized labels. Rendered in HomePage, AccuracyPage, and SeriesDetailPage headers/nav (inside .app__controls).
- frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts: added 'app.theme.group|system|light|dark' to the MessageKey union and BOTH en/ja tables (EN Theme/System/Light/Dark; JA テーマ/システム/ライト/ダーク).
- Tests added: readableTextColor.test.ts (all-team-colors + DEFAULT_COLOR AA >=4.5 contrast, known values, 21:1 black/white), theme.test.ts (pure resolveTheme + readStoredTheme validation), components/ThemeToggle.test.tsx (persistence + data-theme flip). Updated App.test.tsx, HomePage.test.tsx, AccuracyPage.test.tsx render helpers to wrap in <ThemeProvider initialPreference="light"> (they consume useTheme via the toggles now).

DEVIATION: the plan suggested the context could live in theme.tsx. tsconfig forbids importing a path ending in '.tsx' (TS5097, allowImportingTsExtensions off), and theme.ts + theme.tsx would both resolve as './theme' ambiguously. Resolved by naming the context module frontend/src/ThemeContext.tsx; theme.ts holds the pure helpers.

VERIFICATION (from repo root, PATH prefix): `npm run build` GREEN (ordered shared->backend->frontend->infra). `npm test` GREEN, exit 0: shared 34, backend 92, frontend 78, infra 8 = 212 total (baseline 196 + 16 new frontend tests). @axe-core/playwright present in frontend devDependencies; chromium installed under /opt/playwright (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/playwright is set in this env, so the browser is NOT under ~/.cache/ms-playwright; chromium-1243 matches @playwright/test 1.63).

NOTE for later features: AccuracyPage calibration bars use inline aria-hidden decorative colors (#e2e8f0 track, #2563eb fill) left as-is; still legible on dark surfaces. The accuracy nav link color is now var(--accent).
